name: Sports
description: Keeps each person's followed leagues and teams, private to the owner. A whole league can be followed once, and following it again returns the saved follow. A followed team is tied to the provider's permanent team number. The standings picker remembers the leagues a person chose and the standings view they last opened, under the same saved settings as before. Account export and deletion cover all six Sports tables. Following a team needs the provider's team list, which is not part of this package yet, so team follows are refused with the same fail-closed messages the old app gave when the provider was down. Scores, standings data, news sources, source setup, chat tools and the screens are not part of this package yet.

settings.label: Sports
settings.description: Followed leagues and the standings choices can be changed through the Sports routes. The Settings page for them is not part of this package yet.

features.description: Each person keeps private follows of whole leagues and of single teams. Following a whole league twice returns the first follow, so a league never appears twice. Removing a follow deletes only the person's own row. Following a team, or changing which team a saved follow means, needs the provider's team list, which is not part of this package yet, so it is refused until then.

errors.description: The provider's team list is not available, so a team cannot be checked or followed yet.

remediations.description: Follow the whole league for now, then pick the team once team lists are available.

features.description: Follows are tied to the provider's permanent team number, so two teams sharing a short name never swap scores. A team saved before that is put on hold and Sports asks once which team was meant; picking one brings it back. Checking the pick against the provider's team list is not part of this package yet.

The standings picker keeps the leagues a person chose and the competition and view they last opened, on any device, until they pick another. A name that is not a known league is refused. The picker itself is not part of this package yet.
